title: Italia Multimedia — freelance-style web developer collaboration
fit_reasons: The official careers page explicitly offers freelance-like autonomy
Web designers and frontend/backend developers are among the profiles sought
Compensation is described as a fixed monthly amount per managed project
The page accepts spontaneous applications even without a specific open role
material_gaps: WordPress is not specified as a role requirement on the careers page
The exact remote arrangement, project volume and compensation amount are not published
CV and cover letter uploads are mandatory

next_action.reason: Apply through the official form with CV and cover letter, positioning VDS for external WordPress/frontend delivery and ongoing project responsibility without inventing a specific open WordPress vacancy.

outcome.evidence: Official careers page verified 2026-10-11; canonical opportunity/API/active-view search and fresh Hostinger/Gmail Sent checks show no Italia Multimedia history.

notes: Fit 89/100 is an assessment, not a win probability.
State clearly that the proposal is for external technical collaboration and ask whether a Spain-based P.IVA model is accepted.
